description:
Strategic Data Project & Scalability

Senior Symfony Developer (v7.4) – Strategic Data Project & Scalability

Are you a Symfony expert looking for a challenge that matches your experience?

We are hiring a Senior Symfony Developer (minimum 7 years of experience) to lead the technical transformation of a strategic multi-application platform.

This project combines:

  • a complex SaaS architecture,
  • multiple business applications,
  • massive data volumes (more than 26 billion rows),
  • high-level performance, security, and scalability challenges.

Your mission: take over, restructure, stabilize, and industrialize this ecosystem to turn it into a robust and high-performing platform.

The Mission: A Two-Phase ProjectPhase 1 – Transformation & Industrialization (Immediate Priority)

You will play a key role in the technical overhaul of the platform.

Main ResponsibilitiesArchitecture & Audit

  • Full audit of the existing codebase and infrastructure
  • Structural redesign of the platform
  • Multi-application rationalization
  • Code standardization and improvement

Performance & Data

  • SQL optimization (queries, indexing, partitioning)
  • Redis implementation / optimization
  • High-load readiness
  • Overall performance improvements

Reliability & Security

  • Refactoring unstable components
  • Strengthening application security
  • Logs and traceability management
  • Stabilization of the existing environment

Business Development

  • CRM finalization
  • Newsletter module deployment
  • Legal Notices module implementation
  • Data visualization tools / dashboards

Industrialization

  • Migration of legacy scripts to Symfony Workers / message queues
  • CI/CD implementation
  • Monitoring and automated alerts

Phase 2 – Strategic Growth (12 Months)

Once Phase 1 is successfully completed, a long-term mission of approximately 12 months may begin, including:

  • product evolution,
  • international expansion,
  • AI integration and advanced automation,
  • continuous optimization,
  • strategic maintenance.

Phase 2 scope and terms will be defined after successful validation of Phase 1.

Why Join Us?Real Impact

You will take technical leadership of a high-value strategic project.

Technical Freedom

You will actively contribute to architecture decisions and technical direction.

Compensation

  • €3,000 / month
  • Full-time position

Flexibility

  • Remote work possible
  • On-site possible in France
  • 50% contribution to housing / rent costs when travel to France is required

Long-Term Vision

A durable collaboration is planned after successful completion of Phase 1.

Ideal ProfileExperience

  • Minimum 7 years of Symfony development experience
  • Strong Symfony expertise (v7.4 appreciated)

Technical Skills

  • Strong SQL skills
  • Solid software architecture knowledge
  • Performance / scalability experience
  • Good understanding of distributed systems

Mindset

  • Autonomous
  • Rigorous
  • Reliable
  • Results-driven
  • Able to turn technical debt into competitive advantage

Additional Advantages

  • DevOps knowledge
  • Application security
  • Big Data experience
  • Complex SaaS environments

How to Apply

Please send:

  • CV or LinkedIn profile
  • Summary of your Symfony experience
  • Two examples of similar projects completed
  • Your availability
  • Your preference: remote or on-site in France

Only senior candidates with proven expertise will be considered.
